test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The length of a rectangle is 5 cm. The diagonal of the rectangle is 13 cm. What is the area (in square cm) of the rectangle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the Pythagorean Triplet: (5, 12, 13).

If Length = 5 cm and Diagonal = 13 cm, then Width = 12 cm.

Area = Length × Width = 5 × 12 = 60 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Length (l) = 5 cm, Diagonal (d) = 13 cm

Formula: Diagonal² = Length² + Width² (Pythagoras Theorem)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1b6809c646cc1848c9aa4d3bf07202ee570e9b48131125160de5d0ac6fe009a.png] 

⇒ 13² = 5² + w²

⇒ 169 = 25 + w²

⇒ w² = 169 − 25 = 144

⇒ w = √144 = 12 cm

⇒ Area = Length × Width

⇒ Area = 5 × 12 = 60 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perimeter of a Rectangle

The total boundary of the rectangle is given by P = 2 × (length + width).

Common Pythagorean Triplets

Standard integer sets satisfying a² + b² = c² include (3, 4, 5), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25).

Diagonal Property

The diagonal of a rectangle bisects it into two congruent right-angled triangles.
